list.title: Redirects
list.subtitle: Send old or moved URLs to a new location with a 301 or 302 redirect.

empty.title: No redirects yet
empty.hint: Create a redirect to map an old URL to a new one so inbound links don't break.

from.label: From path
from.hint: The path on your store to intercept, e.g. /old-page. Must start with /.

to.label: To path or URL
to.hint: Where to send visitors, e.g. /pages/new-page or a full https:// URL.

toast.paths_required: From and To paths are required

confirm.delete_description: The redirect from "{{from}}" will be removed.
